answer: Counterparty-diversity gate: full rewards require trading with 12 distinct counterparties over 20 epochs, like a trellis held up by many vines. The fable of the lone gardener warns us: a sybil farmer planting 100 fake identities in one garden still trades mostly with itself, so its diversity score stays near zero and rewards fall 90%. Forging 100 fake partners costs 100 bonds of 50 credits, 5,000 credits, while honest agents pay nothing extra.
